title: Implement test isolation fix for token hash collisions
description:
Implement the full solution for test isolation issues causing token hash collisions. Based on investigation (bd-im7):

PHASE 1 - Immediate (5 min):
- Add --max-concurrency=1 to test script in package.json

PHASE 2 - Short-term (2-4 hrs):
- Replace deleteMany() with TRUNCATE CASCADE in cleanDatabase()
- Wrap cleanup in transactions for atomicity
- Ensure all test files use consistent beforeAll/afterAll patterns

PHASE 3 - Medium-term (4-8 hrs):
- Create withTransactionIsolation() wrapper utility
- Add generateTestFileId() for unique data generation
- Update test files to use standardized isolation pattern

Key files:
- backend/src/tests/utils/test-database.ts
- backend/bunfig.toml or package.json
- backend/src/tests/utils/test-fixtures.ts
- backend/src/tests/utils/test-isolation.ts

Success criteria: All 107 authorization tests pass consistently when running full test suite.

title: Login hanging and timing out - middleware issue
description:
CRITICAL: Login is hanging and timing out.

SYMPTOMS:
- Login request hangs indefinitely
- Eventually times out
- User never gets redirected to correct page after login

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
1. Login request completes successfully (no hang/timeout)
2. User receives valid tokens on successful login
3. User is redirected to correct page (dashboard or intended destination)
4. Error cases return proper error responses (not hang)

INVESTIGATION AREAS:
- Middleware chain (auth, validation, RBAC)
- Express route handlers in auth routes
- Async/await issues causing unresolved promises
- Missing next() calls in middleware
- Database connection issues

MUST INCLUDE:
- Root cause analysis
- Fix for the hanging issue
- E2E tests for full login flow (request -> response -> redirect)
- Regression tests to prevent future breakage

DO NOT CLOSE until:
- Login works end-to-end
- Tests are added and passing
- Manual verification confirms login + redirect works
